note: Official registers a founder should search before building, not after. Each entry says what the search PROVES and what a skipped search costs. URLs are the official register only. Nothing here asserts what a search will return.

registers.name: MCA company and LLP name search
registers.proves: Whether the name you want is already taken on the company register, and whether a close variant exists.
registers.if_skipped: Name reservation is rejected, or worse, accepted and later challenged by an existing proprietor. Every artefact carrying the name has to be reissued.

registers.name: Trade mark register search, by class
registers.authority: Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks
registers.proves: Whether an identical or deceptively similar mark is already registered or applied for in the classes you will trade in. A clear company-register search does not imply a clear trade-mark search — they are different registers with different tests.
registers.if_skipped: Opposition or a passing-off claim after launch, forcing a rebrand once the name is on contracts, invoices and store listings.

registers.name: MCA director / DIN master data and disqualification list
registers.proves: Which other companies a prospective co-founder or director is on the board of, and whether they are currently disqualified from being appointed.
registers.if_skipped: A disqualified director invalidates appointments and filings made on their signature, and a co-founder's undisclosed struck-off company surfaces at the worst possible time.

registers.name: MCA index of charges
registers.proves: Whether a company you are investing in, acquiring or lending to has already charged its assets to someone else.
registers.if_skipped: You take security that ranks behind an existing charge, or buy assets that are already encumbered.

registers.name: GST taxpayer search (GSTIN verification)
registers.proves: That a vendor's or customer's GSTIN is live, belongs to the legal name on the invoice, and is registered in the state claimed.
registers.if_skipped: Input credit denied on invoices from a cancelled or fake registration, recovered from you rather than from the supplier.

registers.name: Udyam registration search
registers.authority: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
registers.proves: Whether a supplier is a registered micro or small enterprise, which starts a statutory payment clock you cannot contract out of.
registers.if_skipped: Compounded interest accrues on late payment to an MSME supplier, and the expense can be disallowed for tax.

registers.name: EPFO establishment search
registers.proves: Whether an establishment — yours, or a manpower contractor's — holds a live PF code and is filing.
registers.if_skipped: A contractor who is not remitting makes the principal employer answerable for the contributions.

registers.name: Case status search (eCourts / High Court portals)
registers.proves: Pending litigation against a prospective co-founder, key hire, acquisition target or major supplier.
registers.if_skipped: You inherit a dispute you priced at zero. This is the search investors run on you, so run it first.

registers.name: IBBI insolvency and bankruptcy records
registers.authority: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India
registers.proves: Whether a counterparty is in an insolvency process, which changes who can validly sign and what a payment to them means.
registers.if_skipped: A payment or contract entered into during a moratorium can be unwound.

registers.name: Gazette of India — commencement and amendment notifications
registers.proves: Whether an Act you are planning around is actually in force, and which provisions have been brought into effect. Passage and commencement are different dates, and some provisions never commence.
registers.if_skipped: You build for a rule that is not yet in force, or miss one that came into force last quarter.

registers.name: RBI lists of authorised payment system operators and registered NBFCs
registers.proves: Whether the activity you are describing is one only an authorised entity may carry on, and whether your intended partner actually holds that authorisation.
registers.if_skipped: You build a regulated business on an unauthorised partner, or on the assumption that you do not need authorisation yourself. This is the single most common fatal assumption in Indian fintech.

registers.name: SEBI registered intermediaries search
registers.authority: Securities and Exchange Board of India
registers.proves: Whether an advisory, distribution or research feature you are planning requires registration, and whether a partner holds it.
registers.if_skipped: Unregistered investment advice is an enforcement matter, and 'we only show information' is a distinction the regulator, not you, decides.

registers.name: IRDAI registered insurance intermediaries
registers.authority: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India
registers.proves: Whether the distribution model you have in mind is a registered category, and which one.
registers.if_skipped: Commission arrangements outside a registered category are not enforceable and are an enforcement risk for both sides.

registers.name: Patent and design search (InPASS)
registers.authority: Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks
registers.proves: Whether an incumbent holds a granted patent or a registered design covering the feature you intend to build. A freedom-to-operate signal, not an opinion.
registers.if_skipped: You build a feature you must later remove, and you learn about it from a notice rather than from a search.

registers.name: Copyright register search and voluntary registration
registers.proves: Registration is not required for copyright to exist, but the register is evidence of title and it is what a court looks at first in a dispute.
registers.if_skipped: Ownership is arguable at exactly the moment you need it to be obvious.

registers.name: DPIIT Startup India recognition
registers.authority: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade
registers.proves: Whether the entity qualifies for recognition, which gates several tax and procurement benefits and some state incentives.
registers.if_skipped: Benefits with eligibility windows are missed permanently — recognition cannot be backdated to cover a period already elapsed.

registers.name: Import Export Code (IEC) status
registers.proves: Whether you hold a live IEC, which is required before goods or certain services cross the border, and whether it has been updated in the current year.
registers.if_skipped: Consignments and remittances are held at the bank or the port, which is a cash-flow event before it is a legal one.

registers.name: State single-window clearance portal
registers.proves: Which state approvals your specific address and activity attract, and the deemed-approval clocks that apply. This portal differs by state and so does the list behind it — never assume a neighbouring state's list.
registers.if_skipped: An approval nobody told you about surfaces at inspection, when the premises are already fitted out.

registers.name: State Shops and Establishments registration portal
registers.proves: The registration your actual working address requires — including a co-working desk — and its own renewal cycle, which is a state clock and not the union one.
registers.if_skipped: Inspection findings and closure action against premises that are otherwise perfectly ordinary.

registers.name: State professional tax registration portal
registers.proves: Whether the state levies professional tax, at what slab, and whether you need both an enrolment and a registration.
registers.if_skipped: Arrears recovered for the whole unregistered period, with interest, from the employer rather than the employee.
